settings.title: Default Office Theme
settings.description: Default office canvas theme (startup_office, corporate_office, cozy_cafe, or cyber_ops)

settings.title: Redact Mode
settings.description: Hide sensitive task titles, tool names, message bodies, and event summaries

settings.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
settings.description: Default status polling interval in seconds (2-60)

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Display language for Bot World (auto follows Orca UI locale)

settings.title: Office Atmosphere
settings.description: Office time-of-day lighting atmosphere (auto follows live or replay timestamp; day, sunset, or night overrides lighting)

settings.title: Office Weather
settings.description: Ambient office weather effect (auto follows theme and time of day; clear, rain, snow, or starlight overrides weather)

settings.title: Default View Mode
settings.description: Default visualization mode (office canvas, compact Pocket Pet terrarium, or chroma-key Broadcast bar)

settings.title: Allow Quick Send to Bots
settings.description: Opt-in: allow sending messages and 1-click Needs You decision replies to Orca bots from Bot World (disabled by default for read-only safety)

settings.title: OS Desktop Notifications
settings.description: Opt-in OS alerts when a bot enters Needs You, Error, or Stuck Watchdog state (disabled by default; Redact-safe when Redact Mode is enabled).

settings.title: Stuck Bot Threshold (minutes)
settings.description: Minutes without status, task, or tool change before flagging a Working bot or active sub-worker as stuck (0 disables watchdog).
